acceptance_criteria: The recommendation names the minimum deployable service boundaries and which capabilities remain in the existing UI2 service.
The recommendation maps the requested v1 scope to boundaries without inventing unresolved device semantics.
The recommendation identifies the exact B1-2 schema inputs and unresolved blockers.
The recommendation preserves the current one-image CRC deployment until a later split is justified.
Targeted document/state checks pass and no device contact occurs.

baseline.sequencing: Topology decision before B1-2 schema V1; Java-native UI2 only; Python is reference know-how, not runtime code.

context_not_loaded: docs/history/** except targeted records named by project/build_history.json
invariants: No automatic network-device write or class 2 failover execution.
No raw vendor evidence or secrets in repository artifacts.
Do not turn a scope brief into silent implementation authority.
report.merge_gate: Product Owner review required; DRAFT architecture may not authorize B1-2 implementation until accepted.
report.objective: Produce the smallest DRAFT B1-1M feature-service topology decision for UI2 v1, reconciling Project Plan visibility, discovery/configuration/compliance, backup, and controlled failover without implementing runtime or schema behavior.
output_contract: DRAFT topology decision document or a precise readiness report

recommended_reasoning.reason: Cross-module architecture and sequencing decision with security and schema-boundary implications.

requirements: Read the repository cold-start files in order and use the existing graphify graph before broad browsing.
Keep configuration, runtime inventory, alignment, evidence identity and operational identity separate.
Mark new contract material DRAFT unless an existing frozen authority explicitly permits implementation.
risks: Premature microservice splitting can increase deployment and data-consistency cost.
B1-2 schema fields must not be invented before topology and C1 contract reconciliation.
Controlled failover remains a separate class 2 gated capability.

in: A new DRAFT topology decision document if needed
A concise project-state update only if the decision changes sequencing

validation_plan: JSON and history-index consistency checks if project state changes.
No real-environment or device validation; this is architecture only.
